Lovely 3 course dinner with great service!
Nov 2022 • Couples
My husband and I stayed at the KHOS Hotel which is part of the Hoiana Reaort complex for 6 nights and one night we wanted some Western food and went to the Aroma for their 3 course menu. We started with a mushroom salad which was delicious! For mains I ordered the fish and my husband the beef burger. Both were as good in any western restaurant in Australia! The desert was also a highlight, the mango panna cotta. Thi was our waitress and provided excellent service. It’s a shame as the place is still very quite with travellers slowly returning. Highly recommend if you are staying at Hoiana!
